label: Peak + Removable Shawl
description: The peak lapel with a removable shawl conversion is a bespoke engineering feat that allows a single jacket to present two entirely different formal personae: the assertive, structured peak lapel for daytime and semi-formal occasions, and the smooth, flowing shawl for black-tie events. The shawl element attaches over the peak — usually via hidden buttons or hand-worked hooks at the gorge — and when fitted gives no outward sign of the mechanism beneath. This is the ultimate expression of sartorial versatility, a garment that adapts to the occasion rather than the other way around.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
